- Master Bedroom: 1.8m bed frame with upholstered soft headboard, ergonomic mattress, nightstands, wardrobe/closet options.
- Kids' Room: 1.2m/1.5m solid wood kid's bed with safety guardrails, eco-mattress, study desk/chair set.
